explanation: Two light cheek-to-cheek kisses are the standard greeting in Spain between women, and between men and women, once you're past a first, formal introduction. In business or when meeting someone for the first time, a handshake is the norm, and it tends to stay that way for men meeting men, though colleagues often shift to cheek kisses once a working relationship becomes personal.
local_tip: Lean in and touch cheeks on both sides with a light kissing sound — no actual lip contact — and default to a handshake in a first business meeting or with men you don't know well.

also_check.note: Cheek kissing isn't customary; a bow or handshake is the standard greeting instead.
La bise is standard, though the number of kisses (typically two to four) varies by region.
Cheek kissing between men who are close friends is common, but any greeting involving touch between unrelated men and women in public is generally avoided.
